channel.title: Engineering Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of engineering blog posts from top tech companies

item.title: Native Model Authoring for Edge with LiteRT Tensor API
item.description: Meet the LiteRT Tensor API: giving developers native C++ control over the model graph to unify end-to-end ML computations on heterogeneous edge hardware.

item.title: Unifying Edge AI: How Coral NPU’s open standard brings portable, energy-viable intelligence from model to silicon
item.description: Google Research has completed the 32-bit open-source Coral NPU RISC-V architecture with the introduction of its Matrix Execution Unit, which delivers up to 1 TOPS while targeting 10 mW average power for edge inference Alongside this architecture, the release of the v1.0 open-source IREE/MLIR compiler allows developers to take models from JAX, PyTorch, and TensorFlow straight to Coral NPU hardware without writing custom assembly Developers can now prototype and deploy these multimodal edge applications using new hardware options like the Synaptics Astra SR200 MCU series and globally available Coralboard devkits.12

item.title: Introducing tsrs: a Port of TypeScript to Rust
item.description: Cloudflare is collaborating on tsrs, a Rust port of TypeScript that is up to 8x faster and uses 70% less memory.

item.title: Building Overexposed: understanding application exposure
item.description: Our first scanner read config files and missed what was running We rebuilt it with the cloud inventory, a careful probe, and honest results.

item.title: Cutting our inference bill by 68% by being obsessive about optimization
item.description: When our AI code reviewer's cost per run doubled, we dug into the token usage to find out why Learn how we used prompt caching and intelligent model routing to slash our inference bill by 68% while speeding up reviews.

item.title: How to continue a GitHub Copilot app session in VS Code
item.description: Learn how to move an agent session from the GitHub Copilot app into VS Code without losing the conversation, code changes, or working context The post How to continue a GitHub Copilot app session in VS Code appeared first on The GitHub Blog.

item.title: Introducing Clairic, a new System One class of extraction models
item.description: Clairic is a new model from Cloudflare that is a System One extraction modeI, capable of extracting, computing, estimating, and forecasting data from unstructured inputs.
